description: Na₃CaCPO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.78 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.95 Å. Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.44 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.29 Å) and two longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent CaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-63°. All P-O bond lengths are 1.56 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ca, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Ca, and one C atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃CaC trigonal bipyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ca, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one P atom to form corner-sharing ONa₂CaP tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one P atom.
